description:
Georgia, South Carolina and North Carolina river gauges for fishing and paddling: Cape Fear, Neuse, Tar/Pamlico, Roanoke, Waccamaw, Lumber, Pee Dee, Santee, Cooper, Edisto, Ashley, Congaree, Saluda, Broad, Savannah, Ogeechee, Altamaha, Ocmulgee, Oconee, Satilla, St. Marys, Chattahoochee, Etowah, French Broad, Nantahala, Catawba and Yadkin. USGS gauge height (local gauge datum, not depth), discharge and water temperature, plus the NWS flood category and a separate forecast summary where NWPS publishes one. Tidal gauges are flagged. Gauges that are not reporting stay listed with reporting=false. Optional state=GA|SC|NC and bbox filters.

Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.
name: get_southeast_rivers
title: Georgia, South Carolina and North Carolina river gauges
